retrievalProfile.description: A seated male subject in a bright, airy interior with a mix of elegant script and bold condensed serif typography in the upper left corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man sitting backwards on a metal chair in a spacious, sun-drenched room with large windows, featuring a distinct typographic lockup in the top-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center balancing top-left typography
Soft natural light from windows creating long shadows on the floor

coreInvariants: Seated pose facing the camera over the back of a chair
Large windows in the background showing soft-focus greenery
Top-left alignment for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-scale, positioned in the lower right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark, bold typography in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text, move down the subject's arms to the chair, and rest on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open floor space in the lower left and airy window space in the center.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus photograph of a man with an afro and mustache, wearing a light blue button-down shirt and white trousers, sitting backwards on a vintage metal chair in a bright room with large windows and a concrete floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-part typographic lockup in the top left: a large calligraphic script name overlapping a bold, ultra-condensed serif name in black.
